scope.quality: New authored fixed teacher histories; token-weighted delta-NLL/KL against native reference. Task generation is graded separately.
scope.latency: Diagnostic timing versus native-before/after mean; staging comparison uses affinity-before/after mean when present, otherwise the single affinity-strong arm.
scope.io: Demand PROBE_IO and all ORIGINAL_DEADLINE pread footers are separate and summed; logical requested bytes are not physical disk traffic.
scope.input_files: CSV, stdout JSON, stderr counters and execution JSON only; no raw binary arrays.
